repair_cycle.failing_test: Independent fault replay reproduced declaration-trust, exact-claim, score/decision, canonical-handoff, K1-parity, direct-type, STALE-code and Phase004-entry bypasses
root_causes: Manifest validation trusted declarations without reading input/code files or resolving the Git commit
Synthetic computations used duplicate in-memory constants instead of manifest-bound raw or processed artifacts
Comparison validation accepted an empty freeze registry and did not require the full candidate-by-seed attempt matrix or a successful baseline
Case state validation did not authenticate the history/evidence chain or run STALE before a transition
Raw and processed data were absent from state evidence bindings
Status could serialize unknown sensitive state fields and the negative report used an unmeasured zero
Phase004 start/freeze accepted unverified workspace, commit and shallow manifest declarations
A manifest could name an existing historical Git commit while retaining current code blobs
Configuration hash had no canonical configuration payload from which it could be recomputed
Claim scope and evidence IDs were not bound to final scope or registered current artifacts
Comparison scores, selection decision, retry ledger and reliability denominator were not bound to run outputs and manifests
Split, baseline, aggregation and selection rules were absent from the preregistered freeze
Final and handoff facts were only partially bound and initially overfit the two smoke schemas
Formal sensitive-input and isolated-state boundaries had drifted from selected K1 semantics
Direct validators could raise on nested wrong types and top-level unknown manifest fields
STALE checking omitted code dependencies, dependency chains and repeated-call idempotence
Phase004 entry did not require accepted global RC state or timezone-aware monotonic timestamps
Experiment-plan freeze validation accepted duplicate, unregistered or ill-typed candidates and seeds, empty or overlapping splits, and an empty metric when an attacker recomputed the registry
Direct comparison/Claim validators and the Phase004 audit precondition could raise or accept malformed container and identity types
Run manifests were not initially constrained to the exact preregistered input and fixed trusted execution-code registries at every run Gate
Robustness and per-requirement Claims initially lacked exact selected-output and requirement-specific evidence binding
Direct validators initially raised on non-finite decision fields and malformed terminal history records
STALE dependency chains initially could diverge from terminal history evidence and current dependency mismatches
Public claim-check and compare-check initially unwrapped DRAFT or corrupt artifact records without validating wrapper integrity
Raw Claim and comparison public contracts initially accepted unknown sensitive extensions
